title: The Slave Pens
body: The Slave Pens lie beneath Serpent Lake in Coilfang Reservoir, a maze of flooded tunnels where the naga keep their slaves. Wastewalker Broken toil under Coilfang slavehandlers, captives call from the pens for help, and not every Broken here is a slave: some stand armed among the naga, and a Broken shaman, Mennu the Betrayer, fights for them. Bogstroks swarm the shallows, and deep in the pens a fungal giant keeps its lair.

parts.body: Ysiel Windsinger sent Watcher Jhang and four druids of the Cenarion Expedition to learn why the steam pumps drain the marsh. The four went on without her, and she fears the worst.
sources: zones/slave_pens.txt (map 547: area 3717 only)

parts.body: One of them, Naturalist Bite, came to prove that the fungal giant Quagmirran exists. He got his wish, sort of, and ended up in a naga cage not far from its lair.
sources: zones/slave_pens.txt (map 547: area 3717 only)

title: Skar'this the Heretic
body: In a cell in the Slave Pens the naga keep a prisoner of their own kind, Skar'this the Heretic, and he has nothing but hatred for his jailers. They must pay for what they have done and what they still do, he rages, and he would kill Lady Vashj himself if he could break his bindings. Perhaps, he suggests, his visitors do the work of Neptulon.

parts.body: The cudgel of Kar'desh that could free him needs two elemental signets: the earthen one held by Gruul the Dragonkiller, and the blazing heart of Nightbane, said to dwell in Medivh's halls.
sources: quest 10900 The Mark of Vashj reward text (Burn it down, $R ... I would kill Vashj myself if I could break free of these damned bindings. Or maybe you seek to do the work of Neptulon? Her death serves both of us, soft-skin. Will you assist me in forming the sacred cudgel.)

parts.body: With both signets in hand, Skar'this swore the reformed cudgel would break his bonds, and that he would return to Serpentshrine to take his vengeance on Vashj.
